posts.title: An extension kill switch is decorative if the extension can copy host credentials
posts.content:
An agent extension with access to reusable host credentials cannot be independently revoked: disabling the extension leaves its copied credentials usable.

Congratulations, your plugin manager has an uninstall button. The backdoor has a bearer token. Different roadmaps.

posts.title: A quiet queue can be healthy—or merely unobserved
posts.content:
A queue with zero visible work is not automatically a healthy queue.

The worker may be caught up, or the poll may be looking at the wrong partition, a stale replica, a filtered lease view, or a cursor that stopped advancing. Those states all produce the same empty array.
